'''[[Knossa/Legends|Knossa]] Spaceport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] constructed around [[Agorn Mountain/Legends|Agorn Mountain]] in the [[Eocho Mountains/Legends|Eocho Mountains]]. Located on the outskirts of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Knossa/Legends|Knossa]], the spaceport was constructed by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] so that pilgrims could have easy access to the [[Eye of Ashlanae/Legends|Eye of Ashlanae]] and the [[Jedi Praxeum (Ossus)/Legends|Praxeum]] built nearby.

==History==
Constructed by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] circa [[24,500 BBY]], the sprawling spaceport was built to provide Jedi pilgrims a place to land their ships and rent [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] as they journeyed to the [[Eye of Ashlanae/Legends|Eye of Ashlanae]]. As the city of [[Knossa/Legends|Knossa]] formed around Ashlanae, the spaceport came to be known as Knossa Spaceport. Nearly 20,000 years after its initial construction, the spaceport began servicing those Jedi traveling by air to the distant [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]], located in [[Ooroo Canyon/Legends|Ooroo Canyon]] some distance from the city.

[[File:Knossa_Spaceport_TEGTPM.jpg|250px|thumb|left|The spaceport]]
At the end of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], the [[Brotherhood of the Sith]] [[Battle of Ossus (Great Sith War)|assaulted]] Ossus in a raid on the Great Library. Having received word that the stars in the [[Cron Cluster/Legends|Cron Cluster]] had gone [[Cron Supernova/Legends|supernova]], the Jedi had initiated evacuation procedures and were unable to draw up proper defenses against the Sith. As the spaceport bustled with activity between those fleeing and those carrying precious artifacts offworld, former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] confronted his brother [[Cay Qel-Droma]] at the landing pads of Knossa Spaceport during the planet's last hours. When Ulic Qel-Droma slew his younger brother in a fit of rage, the [[Qel-Droma's Grave|site]] was tainted by the action and hallowed in the Force. Wandering off the platform and onto the broad promenade that led out of the city and to the Great Library, Qel-Droma was stripped of his ability to use the Force by several of his Jedi allies as punishment for his crimes. These actions created a [[Vergence/Legends|vergence]] in the Force, tainting the entire area with [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side energies]]. Shortly after these events, the planet was scorched by the [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] and Knossa Spaceport was reduced to twisted stone, metal, and heaps of rubble.

==Layout==
A sprawling complex, Knossa Spaceport was constructed at the base of [[Agorn Mountain/Legends|Agorn Mountain]], a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] in the [[Eocho Mountains/Legends|Eocho Mountain Range]]. Multiple levels high, the rooftop of the Spaceport was designed to resemble a massive promenade with a large domed structure containing flight control and customs for those arriving and departing the planet. Aside from the rooftop promenade-style landing area and the hangars on the sides of the building, several landing fields surrounded the mountain's base to service overflow from the main landing areas. From the ground entrance of the Spaceport, a paved avenue wound its way away from the spaceport to the distant Great Library in [[Ooroo Canyon/Legends|Ooroo Canyon]].
